title: Neural-arch share of 1.5 kN compression before fracture, erect (2 deg extension) and flexed (2-8 deg)
condition: intact (pre-fracture) elderly FSUs with moderately/severely degenerated discs, after 1 h creep at 1.5 kN

quantity.name: neural-arch load share
quantity.definition: 1500 N minus disc force (integrated vertical stress profile), as % of 1500 N; mean and SEM (Fig. 5); SD derived = SEM x sqrt(16)

source.authors: Farooq N, Park JC, Pollintine P, Annesley-Williams DJ, Dolan P
source.sample: 19 thoracolumbar FSUs (T9-T10 to L5-S1; 8 lumbar) from 12 cadavers; neural-arch analysis n=16 (one outlier >3 SD excluded; final-stage data missing in 2); Adams disc grade 3 (13) or 4 (6)

protocol.summary: FSUs in dental-plaster cups on a hydraulic machine with adjustable rollers. 1 h creep at 1500 N in neutral; then 1500 N static compression for 20 s while a needle pressure transducer is pulled along the mid-sagittal diameter, in 2 deg extension (erect standing) and 2-8 deg flexion (moderate forward bending). Neural-arch force = 1500 N - integrated disc force. Then fracture, vertebroplasty and creep (not extracted).
how_to_simulate: Model an elderly thoracolumbar/lumbar FSU with a degenerated (grade 3-4) disc; fix the caudal vertebra
Erect: rotate to 2 deg extension, then apply 1500 N compression normal to the disc midplane
Flexed: rotate to 2-8 deg flexion, then apply 1500 N
Report neural-arch (facet + posterior element) force as % of 1500 N
protocol.notes: Pre-fracture values only; post-fracture, post-vertebroplasty and post-creep stages are outside the card scope. Text gives the pre-fracture means (53% extension, 12% flexion); SEMs digitised from Fig. 5. n for Fig. 5 not stated in the caption; ANOVA n = 16 used to convert SEM to SD.

data.note: mean from text (Fig. 5 digitised 52.9); SEM digitised 8.3 (+-0.5); SD = SEM x 4
mean from text (Fig. 5 digitised 12.7); SEM digitised 4.9 (+-0.5); SD = SEM x 4

extraction.from: Results text p1726 (means) and Fig. 5 (SEM, digitised at 200 dpi against 0-100% ticks)
extraction.check_notes: Review 52.9 +/- 8.0 = Fig. 5 pre-fracture erect bar; its 8.0 is the SEM, not an SD (SD ~33 with n=16). Review condition 'neutral' is wrong: profiles were taken at 2 deg extension (erect) and 2-8 deg flexion. Specimens are elderly thoracolumbar FSUs, not lumbar only. Re-digitised: bar top 52.9, SEM cap 61.2 (pixel scan).
